title: Multi-LLM abstraction via LiteLLM — provider-agnostic brain (Claude / GPT-4o / Gemini / DeepSeek selectable)
goal: Brain becomes provider-agnostic. `_claude_select_next_action` becomes `_picker_select_next_action(model_provider)`. Default Claude Opus 4.7 (existing prompts tuned for it), but Gemini 2.5 / GPT-4o / DeepSeek V3 selectable per run-config. Customers bring their own API key for preferred provider.
scope: (1) Add `litellm` to requirements. (2) New `api/app/services/llm_provider.py`: LLMProvider abstraction wrapping LiteLLM. (3) Refactor `_claude_select_next_action` + ExploitDeveloper agent (414) + Coordinator (415) calls through LLMProvider. (4) Run-level config: `run.configuration_json['llm_provider']` selects (default claude-opus-4-7). (5) Per-provider response normalization handled by LiteLLM. Cost tracking per provider via OTEL telemetry (backlog-407).
generation_reason: Per OpenClaw architectuur: model-agnostic vanaf dag 1 (supports Claude 4, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0, DeepSeek V3). Open product zonder model-lock-in is differentiator. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: metric is 'XBOW score with non-Claude provider ≥70% van Claude score' (sanity check that abstraction doesn't degrade signal).

constraints.active_task_gate: Single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: LLM abstraction + provider config + refactor of callers only. NO prompt changes.
constraints.default_unchanged: Default provider remains claude-opus-4-7. Existing prompt-tuning preserved.
constraints.cost_visibility: Per-provider cost telemetry via OTEL spans (backlog-407).

success_criteria: Metric: same XBOW challenge solvable with both claude-opus-4-7 AND one alternative provider (gemini-2.5 OR gpt-4o).
Metric: alternative-provider XBOW score ≥70% of Claude score (acceptable degradation; prompts are Claude-tuned).
Run config `llm_provider` selectable; default Claude unchanged.
Cost telemetry visible per provider in Langfuse.
Source-grep sentinel: no direct `import anthropic` in picker / agent code (all routed via LLMProvider).

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with multi-provider comparison + cost data + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
Promote backlog-418 (queue #368 — PentAGI deep-dive) into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Prompt re-tuning per provider (separate task if needed)
